prompts.fireball: Generate ONE production-ready raster skill-icon atlas for a dark-fantasy action RPG. True transparent RGBA background, not black/white/checkerboard and no backdrop. Rich hand-painted high-end ARPG inventory art: sculptural forms, bronze/steel material, sharp bold silhouettes, dramatic directional lighting, saturated magical glow contained within object silhouettes. No letters, numbers, labels, UI frames, borders, watermark, or grid lines. Exactly SIX DIFFERENT icons arranged in a regular 3-column by 2-row grid, reading order left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Every cell is the same size. Each icon centered within its own cell and contained in the middle 65% of that cell, with at least 15% fully transparent margin on every side. Broad fully transparent horizontal and vertical gutters. Icons must not touch or overlap other cells. Each icon must remain readable at 40px. Not pixel art. Canvas landscape 3:2. This is a new atlas, all six icons must be distinct and match one coherent painted style. FIRE MAGIC, blazing amber/orange/red with white-hot yellow cores. Cell 4 (bottom-left) FIRE NOVA: a clear circular orange ring of fire expanding outward around an empty transparent center, bold round silhouette. Cell 5 (bottom-center) SPREADING FLAME: three separate ember flames connected by branching fiery tendrils, triangular cluster silhouette. Cell 6 (bottom-right) DETONATION: a charred skull splitting open with white-hot fire bursting from cracks, bold compact angular silhouette.
